Show thinking

Got it — I see the exact warning now. That pink X in both your screenshots is Chrome saying "Deceptive site / Not secure" for alobo-netizen.github.io.

Your sites are actually loading fine (Nomad shows 5 Builds / 7 Streak, PiQL shows 58K+ Artwork), but that X will kill trust for anyone visiting.

Why it's happening — 99% this:

Your nomad-builder.html and piql-community.html are calling something over http:// instead of https:// — GitHub Pages is HTTPS-only. Chrome sees 1 mixed-content script and flags the whole domain as dangerous.

Common culprits in your builds:

  • http:// IPFS gateway, Alchemy RPC, or WalletConnect CDN
  • http:// fonts / images
  • No <!DOCTYPE html> or missing <meta charset>
  • Form action without HTTPS

Fix — do this in both files right now in Acode:

  1. Open file in Acode → Search http:// → Replace all with https://

  2. Add this at the very top of <head> in both files:

Loading preview...

  1. For PiQL — your Sepolia RPC is probably http://...alchemyapi.io → change to https://eth-sepolia.g.alchemy.com/v2/YOUR_KEY

  2. For Nomad — if you're loading from http://ipfs.io, change to https://ipfs.io

  3. Re-deploy to GitHub Pages, then hard-refresh Chrome: hold the reload button → Empty cache and hard reload.

After that, the X turns into a lock 🔒.

Want me to patch it for you? Upload the actual nomad-builder.html and piql-community.html files (not screenshots) and I'll strip all http:// and add the security headers, then give you back clean files with your new vibrant AjoChain logo style ready to ship.

Will it be better to build these projects on vercel or github.com
15 Aug 2026
Show thinking

For what you're building — Vercel, 100%. Drop GitHub Pages.

That red X you're seeing? GitHub Pages won't auto-fix it. Vercel will.

Here's why for you specifically:

GitHub Pages (what you use now):

  • Static only. No way to hide your Alchemy/Infura key — it's exposed in piql-community.html so anyone can steal it. That's why PiQL keeps hitting rate limits.
  • No auto HTTPS upgrade. If you have one http:// link, Chrome flags your whole alobo-netizen.github.io as dangerous (that's your warning).
  • No functions. You can't run a small backend for Nomad's export-to-X feature.

Vercel (what you should use for PiQL, Nomad, AjoChain):

  • Fixes your warning instantly: Auto HTTPS + upgrade-insecure-requests by default. That X becomes a 🔒.
  • Hides your keys: Put your Alchemy key in Vercel Environment Variables, not in the HTML. PiQL stops breaking.
  • Built for phone: You can deploy straight from GitHub app on your phone. Push to GitHub → Vercel auto-deploys in 30 seconds.
  • Fast in Nigeria: Edge network is way faster than GitHub Pages from Abuja. Your users will feel it.
  • Free for you: Hobby plan is free, custom domain free.

My move for you:

  1. Keep code on GitHub (alobo-netizen)

  2. Deploy all 3 on Vercel:

    • piql.vercel.app
    • nomad-builder.vercel.app
    • ajochain.vercel.app — with that vibrant magenta/yellow Kolo pot logo we locked

  3. In Vercel dashboard:

    • Framework: Vite / Static
    • Add Env Var: VITE_ALCHEMY_KEY = your_key
    • In your HTML/JS: change http:// RPC to https://eth-sepolia.g.alchemy.com/v2/${import.meta.env.VITE_ALCHEMY_KEY}

Result: No more warnings, keys hidden, deploys from your phone in Acode → git push → live.

15 Aug 2026

Yes — Vercel is king, but there are solid free alternatives that do the same thing, some even better for Web3 like PiQL.

Here are the best free ones for you building from your phone in Abuja:

1. Netlify — Closest to Vercel

  • Free: 100GB bandwidth, 300 build mins
  • Drag & drop deploy from phone, auto HTTPS (fixes your X warning)
  • Env vars for your Alchemy key like Vercel
  • Best for: If you want simple. Netlify is slightly easier than Vercel for pure HTML like nomad-builder.html

2. Cloudflare Pages — Fastest in Nigeria

  • Free: Unlimited bandwidth, unlimited sites
  • Uses Cloudflare's edge — your sites will load in <1s from Onitsha/Abuja because Cloudflare has a POP in Lagos
  • Auto HTTPS, super secure, kills that warning
  • Best for: PiQL & AjoChain — fastest for your local users + best free plan

3. Render — Good for backend later

  • Free: Static sites + you can add a small Node.js backend later for free (for Nomad's export feature)
  • Auto HTTPS
  • Downside: Free sites sleep after 15 mins, so first load is slow

4. Web3 Native — Fleek / 4EVERLAND (Perfect for PiQL)

  • Fleek: Hosts on IPFS + ENS. Free. Your NFT art stays decentralized. You get piql.on-fleek.xyz + IPFS hash. No central server can take it down.
  • 4EVERLAND: Same — IPFS hosting, free 100GB. Built for dApps.
  • Best for: PiQL — true Web3 hosting, not Web2.

My ranking for YOU:

  • For speed + free forever: Cloudflare Pages → Your 3 projects will be fastest in Nigeria and never hit limits
  • For ease + from phone: Netlify → Just drag your html files from Acode
  • For Web3 cred: Fleek for PiQL — host NFTs on IPFS, not on Vercel's servers

All of them fix your red X warning because they force HTTPS.

You already have GitHub — so workflow is:
Acode → Git push → Cloudflare/Netlify auto-deploys → 🔒 lock, no warning.

Yes — Vercel is king, but there are solid free alternatives that do the same thing, some even better for Web3 like PiQL.

Here are the best free ones for you building from your phone in Abuja:

1. Netlify — Closest to Vercel

  • Free: 100GB bandwidth, 300 build mins
  • Drag & drop deploy from phone, auto HTTPS (fixes your X warning)
  • Env vars for your Alchemy key like Vercel
  • Best for: If you want simple. Netlify is slightly easier than Vercel for pure HTML like nomad-builder.html

2. Cloudflare Pages — Fastest in Nigeria

  • Free: Unlimited bandwidth, unlimited sites
  • Uses Cloudflare's edge — your sites will load in <1s from Onitsha/Abuja because Cloudflare has a POP in Lagos
  • Auto HTTPS, super secure, kills that warning
  • Best for: PiQL & AjoChain — fastest for your local users + best free plan

3. Render — Good for backend later

  • Free: Static sites + you can add a small Node.js backend later for free (for Nomad's export feature)
  • Auto HTTPS
  • Downside: Free sites sleep after 15 mins, so first load is slow

4. Web3 Native — Fleek / 4EVERLAND (Perfect for PiQL)

  • Fleek: Hosts on IPFS + ENS. Free. Your NFT art stays decentralized. You get piql.on-fleek.xyz + IPFS hash. No central server can take it down.
  • 4EVERLAND: Same — IPFS hosting, free 100GB. Built for dApps.
  • Best for: PiQL — true Web3 hosting, not Web2.

My ranking for YOU:

  • For speed + free forever: Cloudflare Pages → Your 3 projects will be fastest in Nigeria and never hit limits
  • For ease + from phone: Netlify → Just drag your html files from Acode
  • For Web3 cred: Fleek for PiQL — host NFTs on IPFS, not on Vercel's servers

All of them fix your red X warning because they force HTTPS.
